searchTerms.title: Search terms or Amazon search URLs
searchTerms.description: Keywords, or full Amazon search URLs. A URL must contain a k= keyword — Amazon serves node-only category URLs (rh=n%3A..., node=..., /b?...) as a browse page with no results for logged-out clients. Filters and sorts work fine alongside a keyword, e.g. /s?k=yoga+mat&rh=n%3A3407731&s=price-asc-rank

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain to search. Prices are pinned to this marketplace's currency regardless of where the run exits from.

maxPages.title: Pages per search term
maxPages.description: Amazon stops serving a next-page link after about 7 pages on a broad query; the actor stops on its own when a term runs out, so a high value costs nothing extra.

maxItemsPerTerm.title: Max items per term
maxItemsPerTerm.description: Hard cap on products emitted per search term. 0 means no cap.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored results
includeSponsored.description: Sponsored placements are flagged with isSponsored either way. Turn this off to keep only organic results for a cleaner price distribution.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between pages (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pacing between requests. Amazon serves CAPTCHAs to traffic it dislikes.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy strongly recommended. It also determines the delivery country, which is what makes Prime and delivery fields meaningful.
